chapters.title: Breakfast
chapters.text: You sat at a wooden table in the dining room. You had a plate of scrambled eggs, tomatoes, and toast, alongside a ceramic mug.

chapters.title: Kitchen Preparation
chapters.text: You prepared vegetables together in the kitchen. You cut carrots on a wooden board.
caregiver_facts: The caregiver and the older woman prepared vegetables together.

chapters.title: Reading Time
chapters.text: You sat in an armchair by the window and read an open book. A mug rested on a small wooden table next to you.

chapters.title: Visit with Anna
chapters.text: Your daughter Anna visited you. You sat on the sofa together and looked through a photo album.
caregiver_facts: The visitor was her daughter Anna.
Anna and the older woman looked through a photo album together.

chapters.title: Dinner
chapters.text: You sat at a wooden table in the dining room with a plate of food and a mug.
